title: AlignR Preference Pair
description: Schema for a single preference pair in the AlignR training dataset.

prompt_id.description: SHA-256 hash (first 16 chars) of the prompt text

prompt.description: The user query shown to annotators

annotator_role.description: Role of annotator e.g. claims_adjuster, compliance_officer

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of annotation event

rationale.description: Free-text rationale for the preference decision

iaa_score.description: Cohen's kappa inter-annotator agreement score. Null for bootstrap data.

domain.description: Industry domain e.g. insurance, banking, healthcare, legal
